An & that would read as a character reference in a link destination or title stays literal

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<a href=\"?&amp;plus;\" title=\"&amp;plus;\">T</a>", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
